title: Matcha Nimono Smoothie
description: A refreshing and energizing smoothie that combines the flavors of matcha and nimono.

ingredients.name: Matcha powder
ingredients.notes: High-quality matcha powder for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Nimono
ingredients.notes: Japanese-inspired pickled vegetables for added flavor

ingredients.name: Energizing honey
ingredients.notes: Optional, for a touch of sweetness

instructions: Combine Canadian ice cream, matcha powder, nimono, and vegan milk in a blender
Add energizing honey if desired for a touch of sweetness
Pour into a glass and serve immediately
Garnish with a sprinkle of matcha powder if desired
